ThingDef.label: Colt Model 607A
ThingDef.description:
Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.
The Colt Model 607 was the first dedicated carbine variant of the M16, designed in the mid-1960s to meet the US military's need for a compact, high-firepower weapon for special forces. As the pioneer of the CAR-15 lineup, it introduced a unique, short barrel paired with a modified triangular buttstock that could manually collapse to reduce its profile. While its extreme muzzle blast and complex stock mechanism prevented widespread adoption, it laid the direct evolutionary groundwork for iconic later carbines like the XM177 and the modern M4. The 607A model improved on the base 607 by incorporating a forward assist.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (Folded)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant's stock has been folded.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (25Rnd)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 25-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant uses a rare, early 25-round AR-15 test magazine.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (30Rnd)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 30-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant uses a later production 30-round magazine.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (30Rnd Folded)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 30-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant uses a later production 30-round magazine, and the stock has been folded.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (100Rnd CMAG)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 100-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant has been fitted with a 100-round Beta C-Mag.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (150Rnd)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 150-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant has been fitted with a 150-round Armatac SAW-MAG.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (180Rnd)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 180-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant has been fitted with a 180-round drum made by combining two 90-round MWG "Ninety Rounder" magazines.

li.label: Colt Model 607A (Scope)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant has an attached Colt 3x20 scope.

li.label: Colt Model 607A BFH
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant replaces the standard 607-style moderator with a birdcage-style flash hider as used on the later M16A1.

li.label: Colt Model 607A BFH (Folded)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant replaces the standard 607-style moderator with a birdcage-style flash hider as used on the later M16A1, and the stock has been folded.

li.label: Colt Model 607A CFH
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant replaces the standard 607-style moderator with the experimental conical flash hider developed for the Colt Model 608.

li.label: Colt Model 607A DFH
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant replaces the standard 607-style moderator with a three prong/"duckbill"-style flash hider as used on the M16.

li.label: Colt Model 607A DFH (Folded)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant replaces the standard 607-style moderator with a three prong/"duckbill"-style flash hider as used on the M16, and the stock has been folded.

li.label: Colt Model 607A DFH (30Rnd)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 30-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant replaces the standard 607-style moderator with a three prong/"duckbill"-style flash hider as used on the M16, and uses a later production 30-round magazine.

li.label: Colt Model 607A DFH (30Rnd Folded)
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 30-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant replaces the standard 607-style moderator with a three prong/"duckbill"-style flash hider as used on the M16, uses a later production 30-round magazine, and the stock has been folded.

li.label: Colt Model 607A XM148
li.description: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO. 20-round detachable mag. Select-Fire.\n\nThis variant has been modified to accommodate an XM148 grenade launcher.
